CITY OF SAN MARINO

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Susan Jakubowski, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Steve Talt, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 14, 2019 AT 8:30 A.M.
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Council with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular Meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
Adjourned Meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should
contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 300-0705 prior to the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang.

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the
following locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890
Huntington Drive, and the Recreation Department, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special
meeting agenda is also posted on the City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS (AGENDA ITEMS ONLY)

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council
by completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the
meeting. At this time, the public may address the City Council only on items on the
 SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA – AUGUST 14, 2019  PAGE 2 OF 2

agenda pursuant to Government Code Section 54956. Pursuant to state law, the City
Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on
duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  NEW BUSINESS

  1. CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-19-25, A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO
  AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. R-19-21 AS PERMITTED BY
  ELECTIONS CODE SECTION 9605, TO AMEND THE LANGUAGE
  OF THE BALLOT QUESTION RELATING TO THE SPECIAL
  PUBLIC SAFETY TAX FOR PARAMEDIC SERVICES, FIRE
  PROTECTION AND PREVENTION, AND POLICE PROTECTION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-
  19-25, a resolution of the City Council of the City of San Marino amending
  Resolution No. R-19-21 as permitted by elections code section 9605, to amend
  the language of the ballot question relating to the special public safety tax for
  paramedic services, fire protection and prevention, and police protection.

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: August 13, 2019  EVA HETER
Posted: August 13, 2019  CITY CLERK
